author: BmB
body:
Hi, before you read the appeal this is BmB here can I just say that I didn't write any of this. But Strictly got confused so I said that I would post it for him.  But can I add that Strictly is actually very sincere in this appeal and I truly believe he deserves another shot at Avicus as it was once a server he was involved in the community of, loved and played regularly.

IGN: StrictlyBusiness
Infraction: "Inappropriate Links" 

Can I start this appeal by saying that my use of the inappropriate link was actually accidental. I am not saying that I didn't deserve to be banned for it as what happened was indeed bannable, however, it was a mistake. What happened was I posted a link to the site PornHub with /BmB on the end in a public game not expecting the link to work. But, unfortunately, the link obviously registered as an error but then redirected you to the PornHub homepage which I did not intend. Now I regret even trying to do what I thought to be a harmless joke completely. 

I am starting to miss Avicus quite a lot and feel disconnected from a lot of my friends and I was actually incredibly disappointed when the tournament was released and I knew that I couldn't participate but I feel that I have waited long enough and I hope you understand that I believe everyone deserves a second chance especially as this is my first permanent ban.  I would be so grateful if were to be pardoned and I could  reconnect myself with Avicus.  

Finally, I am very sorry and thank you for taking the time to read and evaluate my appeal, StrictlyBusiness.
